project_name.justification: The article title is 'Sasquatch Resources Exercises Option to Acquire Mineral Claim Comprising The Company's Mount Sicker Property'.

company_name.justification: The press release is from 'SASQUATCH RESOURCES CORP.(CSE:SASQ) ("Sasquatch " or the "Company")'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The document is signed 'On Behalf of the Board of Directors Peter Smith Chief Executive Officer'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company 'successfully exercised its option to acquire the British Columbia mineral claim comprising the Company's Mount Sicker Property'. The effect is for 'Sasquatch to own its Mount Sicker Property'.

primary_commodity.justification: Methodical testing has shown the waste rock to contain good values for gold, copper, silver and zinc...

verified_article_link.justification: The article content and title, 'Sasquatch Resources Exercises Option to Acquire Mineral Claim Comprising The Company's Mount Sicker Property', directly relate to the specified project.

currency.justification: The company is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE) and the payment is denoted with a '$' symbol, implying Canadian Dollars. 'The CSE has not reviewed, approved or disapproved the contents of this news release.'

cash_payments_raw.justification: Pursuant to the option agreement... the Company has fulfilled its third year option obligations by making an aggregate cash payment of $100,000...

share_payments_raw.justification: No explicit total share value was provided. The consideration was described by the number of shares and price per share, which are captured in other fields.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The text provides separate values for cash and share components, not a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: ...and by issuing an aggregate of 800,000 common shares to the Optionors.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any share warrant payments as part of the transaction.

issued_share_price.justification: The shares were issued in accordance with applicable securities laws at a price of $0.07 per share...

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not mention any exploration commitment in meters.
